import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> g;
    static int[] level, ptr;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        g.get(u).add(new Edge(v, g.get(v).size(), c));
        g.get(v).add(new Edge(u, g.get(u).size() - 1, 0));
    }

    static boolean bfsLevels(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        level[s] = 0;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : g.get(u)) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] != -1;
    }

    static int dfsFlow(int u, int t, int f) {
        if (u == t) return f;
        for (int i = ptr[u]; i < g.get(u).size(); ++i) {
            Edge e = g.get(u).get(i);
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                int pushed = dfsFlow(e.to, t, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.cap -= pushed;
                    g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
            ptr[u]++;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int total = 0;
        level = new int[t + 1];
        ptr = new int[t + 1];
        while (bfsLevels(s, t)) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfsFlow(s, t, 10000)) > 0) total += pushed;
        }
        return total;
    }

    static int n, T, sinkNode;
    static int[][] srcCap = new int[10][10];
    static int[][] snkCap = new int[10][10];
    static int[][] srcId = new int[10][10];
    static int[][] snkId = new int[10][10];
    static int[][][] plant = new int[10][10][61];
    static final int[] dr = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] dc = {-1, 1, 0, 0};

    static boolean ok(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && r < n && c >= 0 && c < n;
    }

    static class State {
        int tm, r, c;
        State(int tm, int r, int c) {
            this.tm = tm;
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        String[] grid = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) grid[i] = br.readLine();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char c = grid[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y' || c == 'Z') {
                    plant[i][j][0] = c - 'X';
                    srcCap[i][j] = 0;
                } else {
                    plant[i][j][0] = 0;
                    srcCap[i][j] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) grid[i] = br.readLine();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char c = grid[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y' || c == 'Z') {
                    plant[i][j][0] = c - 'X';
                    snkCap[i][j] = 0;
                } else {
                    plant[i][j][0] = 0;
                    snkCap[i][j] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int tm = 1; tm <= T; ++tm) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                    plant[i][j][tm] = plant[i][j][tm - 1];

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                    if (plant[i][j][tm - 1] == 2)
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int ni = i + dr[d], nj = j + dc[d];
                            if (ok(ni, nj) && plant[ni][nj][tm - 1] == 0)
                                plant[ni][nj][tm] = 2;
                        }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                srcId[i][j] = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                snkId[i][j] = -1;

        sinkNode = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (srcCap[i][j] != 0) srcId[i][j] = sinkNode++;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (snkCap[i][j] != 0) snkId[i][j] = sinkNode++;

        g = new ArrayList<>(sinkNode + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= sinkNode; ++i) g.add(new ArrayList<>());

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (srcCap[i][j] == 0) continue;
                Queue<State> q = new LinkedList<>();
                q.add(new State(0, i, j));
                boolean[][] vis = new boolean[n][n];
                vis[i][j] = true;
                int src = srcId[i][j];
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    State cur = q.poll();
                    int tm = cur.tm;
                    int r = cur.r;
                    int c = cur.c;
                    if (snkCap[r][c] != 0) addEdge(src, snkId[r][c], 10000);
                    if (tm == T) continue;
                    if (plant[r][c][tm] != 0) continue;
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int nr = r + dr[d], nc = c + dc[d];
                        if (ok(nr, nc) && plant[nr][nc][tm] == 0 && !vis[nr][nc]) {
                            vis[nr][nc] = true;
                            q.add(new State(tm + 1, nr, nc));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (srcCap[i][j] != 0) addEdge(0, srcId[i][j], srcCap[i][j]);
                if (snkCap[i][j] != 0) addEdge(snkId[i][j], sinkNode, snkCap[i][j]);
            }
        }

        pw.println(maxFlow(0, sinkNode));
        pw.flush();
    }
}
